page.notes: No running head, page number, catchword or signature is printed. The decorative rule between the epigraph and the heading is an ornament, not text. The first letter of thesis 1 is a large initial N, joined to the word "omen". "Jehova" is set in small capitals in the print; the rendering here is approximate. The Hebrew line under thesis 4 is a continuation of that thesis, printed on its own line; the reading is uncertain and is marked [?]. The epigraph's italic passages are marked with <i>, and the long s is written as a plain s throughout.
